findings.summary: Fundraising heart pixels pulse indefinitely without a pause or stop control.
findings.fix: Make fundraising progress pixels static or stop pulsing within five seconds; respect prefers-reduced-motion. The percentage and static heart convey the progress without animation.
findings.evidence: Production fundraising is 47% funded with 15 faded rects; computed animation is pixel-pulse 3s infinite even with reducedMotion=reduce; control inventory contains menu, search, theme and donate, no pause.

passed: Theme toggle is explicitly 45 by 45 CSS pixels.
Both automatic prefers-color-scheme and explicit light/dark theme variants exist.
Global anchors and buttons have focus outlines, subject to local overrides.
Dark-theme link-green foreground #93D7B7 against #0e1117 is above 4.5:1; muted text is lightened for dark theme.
notes: No blanket failure assigned for absent reduced-motion media query: short transitions alone do not fail WCAG AA.
Target-size assessment for other components needs runtime geometry and spacing exceptions.
Best practices: short smooth scrolling and transition effects do not adapt to reduced motion; no standalone AA failure assigned.

Source color recipes verified in production and consolidated into cross-page-analyzer findings; production main background is #ffffff rather than source $white #F1FFF7. Search-filter focus candidate not runtime confirmed and removed from scored findings.
Production motion finding verified by reduced-motion computed styles and complete visible control inventory; all palette defects are emitted only by cross-page-analyzer to avoid duplicates.
